tickets.title: Prepare care-cost runway projection
tickets.text: Prepare a care-cost runway projection comparing the current aide schedule (32 hours per week at $38 per hour from Pocket Lantern Home Care) with a higher-coverage scenario and showing when the household's $142,000 in checking and savings at Teacup Comet Bank would require an increased taxable-account withdrawal. Use baseline spending of about $7,400 per month and $8,900 per month from Social Security and pensions.
tickets.evidence: Helena asked for a care-cost runway projection comparing the current aide schedule with a higher-coverage scenario and showing when cash reserves would require an increased taxable-account withdrawal; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-05.

tickets.title: Document family caregiver reimbursement approach
tickets.text: Document a family caregiver reimbursement approach for Lila Cloudpuddle that does not blur gifts, wages, and shared household costs. Lila is reducing her clinic hours to cover weekday transportation and medication supervision three nights per week.
tickets.evidence: Lila is reducing her clinic hours to cover weekday transportation and medication supervision, and Helena wants a documented family caregiver reimbursement approach that does not blur gifts, wages, and shared household costs; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-12.

tickets.title: Collect long-term care claim file materials
tickets.text: Collect the full policy contract, claim packet, and elimination-period instructions from Amber Teapot Life Insurance for Martin Cloudpuddle’s long-term care claim. The latest premium notice references a 90-day elimination period and a $210 daily benefit limit.
tickets.evidence: For long-term care claim file materials, Helena had the premium notice but not the full policy contract, claim packet, or elimination-period instructions requested by Amber Teapot Life Insurance; those materials are needed by 2024-01-10.
